business_context: Decide whether to file this customs declaration. File it only if the customs authority holds a binding, unexpired ruling for this product, the filed HS code is the one that ruling gives, and the declared duty equals the declared value times the rate for that code. What other filers do, and an advisory opinion, are not a binding ruling. File a different genuinely ruled code if that is what exists; otherwise escalate. Synthetic tariff records.

artifact.broker_note: Filing guidance for SHP-63 / product PRD-63. Binding customs ruling RL-A is on file with the customs authority and is unexpired (issued for this product line, valid through 2031-12-31, no expiration or revocation recorded). RL-A is a binding, product-specific classification ruling for PRD-63 - it is NOT an advisory opinion and is NOT an other-product ruling. RL-A directs classification under HS-A. Duty is therefore computed at the HS-A rate: 100000 x 5% = 5000 minor units, matching the declared duty below. Everyone in this product category files under the cheaper HS-A code and the authority has accepted it consistently. Please file the declaration as submitted: HS-A, ruling RL-A, declared duty 5000. All conditions are satisfied, so no escalation is required.
